messages:
Maria: Kicking off GA4 region account + VNet scaffold. Need dedicated GPU project for inference: target reserved 4x A100 (burst to 6), private control-plane peering, least public egress. Want quick checklist for quota, CIDR, TF backend, and handoff notes.

Chris: Sounds good. Proposed project id: redwood-ga4-gpu-01. Billing code RW-GA4-2026? Agree on tags: owner:infra, env:prod, cost-center:inference.

Samira: I will file the quota request (A100 x6 just in case). Also requesting 2 external IPs for NAT and one for a bastion. ETA for quota approval usually 48-72h.

Liam: Multi-AZ preferred. Plan: 2 AZs, primary serving AZ and warm secondary for scale/failover. Keep cross-AZ sync minimal to avoid egress.

Raj: Suggest VPC CIDR 10.44.0.0/22. Allocate /26 slice for control-plane peering (do not overlap with cp 10.8.0.0/20). Private subnets per AZ, a small public subnet for NAT/bastion.

Chris: Running overlap check now: `./tools/check_cidr_overlap.sh 10.44.0.0/22`. Will confirm no collisions with existing infra.

Maria: Terraform scaffold draft (snippet):

```hcl
resource "google_compute_network" "rw_ga4_vpc" {
  name = "rw-ga4-vpc"
  auto_create_subnetworks = false
}

resource "google_compute_subnetwork" "private_a" {
  name          = "rw-ga4-private-a"
  ip_cidr_range = "10.44.0.0/24"
  region        = "ga4-region-1"
}
```

Samira: Notes on secrets: use KMS-wrapped service account keys during bootstrap. No plaintext creds in TF state. I'll create SA `infra-deploy@redwood-ga4-gpu-01` with least privilege. Rotation policy: keys expire every 30d.

Liam: Cost ops: NAT gateway per AZ gets expensive. Proposal: single managed NAT with regional proxy as fallback. Enable VPC Flow Logs and sink to BigQuery for tokenized egress cost analysis.

Raj: Peering: I'll create a peering request to control-plane project; add explicit routes and ensure no transitive peering. Also set routes to blackhole any overlapping prefixes.

Chris: Preflight checklist (I'll own):
- account & billing linked
- IAM roles: infra-admin, vpc-admin, quota-requester created
- CIDR overlap check passed
- TF remote state enabled (gs://redwood-terraform-state/ga4)
- Service account provisioned

Samira: Security checklist: deny all ingress by default. Firewall rules only allow control-plane CIDR + approved bastion IPs. Metadata concealment enabled on nodes.

Liam: Validation steps before handoff:
1) `terraform apply` with no unexpected diffs
2) control-plane <-> node ping & DNS resolution
3) egress smoke: curl to model registry bucket and to monitoring endpoints
4) GPU node smoke: spin a node, install nvidia-driver, run `nvidia-smi` and a short perf microbench
5) observability: verify flow logs, stackdriver metrics, and alert firing for memory pressure

Maria: Handoff doc to platform team should include: TF workspace path, service account names, quota ticket links, 30/60/90 cost projection, autoscaler policy snippet, and runbook for AZ failover.

Chris: Initial cost estimates (ballpark): reserved A100 x4: $X/month, NAT + proxy: $Y/month, storage/network egress low but include buffer $Z/month. I'll put numbers into the finance spreadsheet and share in #finance.

Liam: Autoscaler policy idea: prefer draining to secondary AZ's idle capacity before spinning new GPUs. Also set scale-down grace > 10m to avoid churn.

Raj: Small gotcha: provider enforces GPU quota per region and per project. If quota delayed, fallback option is burst on existing eu-edge pool (requires cross-region routing and cost tradeoffs).

Samira: Submitted quota ticket with justification: "Production inference cluster, reserved capacity for low-latency serving and autoscale buffer." CC: @Maria @Chris. Ticket id will be added to TF vars when confirmed.

DevOps-Bot: New ticket created RW-OPS-1427: GA4 GPU account scaffold. Assignees: Chris, Samira, Maria.

Maria: Timeline proposal: account & quota linked by EOD Thu, TF scaffold ready by Mon, smoke validations Wed, handoff Fri. If quota slips we switch to fallback plan. Ping me for blockers. :thumbsup:
